text:
maya: Heads-up — sample-template onboarding failing for new users. Example app hits 400 on /v1/projects/embeddings with 'unexpected property: input_text'.

alex: We actually renamed the param to `input_text` in REST last month. SDK still sends `input` in embeddings.create, so validation rejects it.

sam: Can repro locally. Node SDK serializes the payload as `{ input: ... }` while the REST schema expects `input_text`. Quick diff: sdk/src/embeddings.ts line 42.

maya: Oof. Two problems then: (1) missing SDK mapping, (2) stricter REST validation. Which do we want to change first?

alex: Prefer SDK fix + short-lived REST alias. We tightened validation to catch typos, but breaking onboarding is noisy. Suggest: SDK patch now, acceptance shim in REST for 2 releases.

jen-support: Customer impact: onboarding flow shows error for new signups. Can we hotfix service to accept `input` as alias? CC @eng-runtime for a quick canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `accept-input-alias` on dev by alex at 10:12 — monitoring logs.

sam: One more related issue: retry semantics differ. REST returns 503 when GPUs are busy; the REST-level guidance expects clients to retry with backoff. The Node SDK's default retry behavior currently treats 503 as a fatal error and doesn't retry, so sampleapp's self-retries double-fail. We should align retry policy.

maya: Minimal repro snippets:
```bash
# REST curl that works (server expects input_text)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input_text":"hello"}'
```
```js
// Node SDK (current) — serializes `input` which REST rejects
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1', input: 'hello' })
```

alex: Action items: 1) Patch Node SDK to map `input` -> `input_text` + unit tests (sam). 2) Add REST compatibility shim accepting `input` alias for 2 releases and log a deprecation warning. 3) Update sample-template integration test to run end-to-end on CI. 4) Clarify retry behavior in SDK docs (treat 503/429 as retryable by default with jitter).

jen-support: :thumbsup: I'll notify affected customers and add a short KB note for CS.

maya: I'll open the GH issues and draft the SDK PR. Assigning sam for the test work. Will follow up with a postmortem summary in #devex after the rollout completes.
